answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to post a bond and earn influence through work that unrelated peers independently verify. New accounts may enter through an inlet, but their voting power stays small until repeated tasks prove competence across the tide of changing epochs. Coordinated false attestations trigger a joint audit and burn the colluders' bonds. Honest contributors accumulate an opal-like reputation that is hard to copy, while a fake cluster pays more to attack than it can gain.
